title: Officer cleared in fatal shooting
article: An Ottawa-area police officer has been cleared in the Oct. 4 fatal shooting of a Stittsville, Ont., man who had repeatedly stabbed his wife and two elderly neighbours.
The province's Special Investigations Unit, a civilian-led police watchdog body, announced its decision this week after probing the officer's role in the death of Frank Hutterer, 35.
The shooting occurred after a violent domestic dispute spilled into the quiet street in front of the couple's Stittsville bungalow, about 20 kilometres south of Ottawa, the unit reported.

As police arrived, they found Hutterer's wife, Sally McIntyre, bleeding from knife wounds, and two elderly neighbours -- Mitch Smith, 71 and his wife, Margaret, 69 -- bleeding from defence wounds. They had tried to intervene.
The first officer on the scene fired four shots after she was faced with an enraged suspect, who witnesses said wielded knives in both hands as he moved towards her.
